description: Header file defining the MessageControl class, which implements messaging and plugin interfaces, manages message dispatching, connection notifications, and configuration for a messaging plugin in the WPEFramework.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class implementing messaging control, plugin interfaces, connection notifications, message dispatching, and configuration management.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A thread class used internally by MessageControl to handle dispatching in a separate thread.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for MessageControl settings, including network node info and output options.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications and message observation, managing attach/detach states.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MessageControl plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel to the messaging control.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel from the messaging control.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements or messages.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches a message to all interested parties.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the message collection callback.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for a category and module.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Returns an iterator over message control settings.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to process message updates.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up message outputs and files.
